questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the first-lobe zero-bias peak or the even-odd length dependence? Page 2 says the six devices "showed similar results"; how many showed each signature, over how many cooldowns?
Why were the other four devices set aside?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: back-gate voltage outside −1.2 V to −0.8 V at 110 mT, field angles (you had a three-axis magnet), and temperature for the zero-bias peak?
What do the second-best tunneling device and the second-best island series look like?
How long is the bare InAs segment between the barrier and the end of the shell in device 1, and do finite-bias scans of it show dot resonances at zero field?
At strong coupling in Fig. S3B, what is the zero-bias dip value in units of 2e^2/h, and was the 6.7 kΩ line resistance subtracted before plotting conductance?
For each island, how many gate configurations went into Table S1, how widely did A vary between them, and how was the plunger window for the averages in Fig. 4E chosen?
Did you tunnel into the other end of the device 1 wire, or into any device 2 island with its junctions opened?
